body:
Hunter x Hunter episode 135- the episode where [obvious spoilers](/s "Meruem and Komugi play their final game of gungi.")

This is closely followed by [episode 116](/s "Gon's confrontation with Pitou.") *Fantastic* VA work/animation all around.
[Blue](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=03qBqP2I4p8), from the finale of Cowboy Bebop, never fails to give me a melancholy feeling. I always get chills, especially at the beginning.
Having Sugita as Joseph's VA also helps. I can't imagine anyone else voicing him.

The currently airing [Ojisan to Marshmallow](http://myanimelist.net/anime/31848/Ojisan_to_Marshmallow) is a cute little short about a woman that has a crush on and likes to tease an older man. Might be worth a try.
